study.research_question: Does the matched final-verdict engine change verified task success, observed repair burden and total consumption when evidence, criteria, feedback and Astra root are held fixed?
study.research_gap: Component decisions alone do not establish downstream task completion, recovery, or full task burden.
study.hypothesis: Jev may lower repeated verification cost or latency, but wrong judgments may add repair burden or falsely accept incomplete work.

primary_metric.name: matched_verdict_task_success_delta
primary_metric.aggregation: (Jev passed inboxes minus LLM passed inboxes) / 6 paired executions

study.decision_rule: Diagnostic only. Both new admission arms must be valid and successful with reviewed playback before natural dispatch. No adoption, release or publication authority.
study.invalidation_rule: Stop on incomplete exports, observation/checker/source/usage/credential failure or timeout. Preserve invalid trials as unknown; any missing/invalid planned cell makes primary not measurable. Valid semantic failures continue.
study.analysis_plan: Three authored inboxes x two engines x two repetitions. Report item correctness, false acceptance, hold, judgment/replan/root/tool calls, actual feedback consumption, latency, tokens and tariff estimates. Three independent tasks, not twelve. No pooling with old cohorts or snapshot probes. Replay preselected inbox-explicit repetition0, LLM left/Jev right even failure. Retrospective disclosure only; original prospective contract is source-contract.json.

environment.reset_strategy: Fresh public-network agent and separate static no-network verifier containers per cell; native Harbor artifact transfer only. No operator workspace mounted. Provider-free actual infrastructure proof expires after 24h. Root 180s, Harbor agent 210s, host watchdog 930s plus cancellation cleanup up to 120s. No trial rerun or helper HTTP retry; identical bounded root retry policy inherited.

comparison.comparator: A: Astra subscription/xhigh typed final verdict; B: direct jev-1.13.0 typed final verdict. Both lookup-only Astra roots with common feedback and default cognitive reflection.

privacy.redaction_boundary: Reviewed file/field projection; private prompts, reasoning and machine paths withheld.
